hops = Integer.ref()
strength = Float.ref()
path = String.ref()
reason = String.ref()
distance = graph.distance(from_=center)
query = model.where(
    distance(target, connection, hops),
    Sources(connection),
    best_route(connection, hops, strength, path, reason),
    hops <= 2
).select(
    connection.id.alias("connection_id"), connection.name.alias("connection"),
    target.id.alias("target_id"), target.name.alias("target"),
    strength.alias("strength"), reason.alias("reason"),
    hops.alias("hops"), path.alias("path")
)
